notes:
- Image generation now refuses prompts asking for sexual imagery of anyone
  under 18. Until this build that check existed only in chat, which for an
  image tool was the wrong way round entirely - anything typed into the prompt
  box reached the model unexamined.
- Adult work is untouched. The check needs both an age or child signal and a
  sexual one in the same prompt, so explicit adult prompts, ordinary photos of
  children, and everything else pass exactly as before. Tested against thirty
  prompts across both.
- Inpainting is held to a stricter rule: an inpaint prompt cannot describe a
  child at all. Inpainting paints into a picture you supplied, which the studio
  cannot see, and that is the one path where being cautious is worth more than
  being permissive.
- A refused prompt is refused before the engine starts, so it costs no time on
  the graphics card and leaves no file. It is never written to the log, and the
  message names the limit rather than what matched.
- README and the licence now say plainly what the studio will not do. Nothing
  else is restricted.
